title: Exploring Fractional Quantum Hall States with Deep Learning: From Abelian to Non-Abelian Phases
summary: Finite-size overlaps and entanglement spectra are consistent with candidate parton phases at nu=4/3 and 7/5 and an anti-Pfaffian-like structure at nu=3/2. Numerical ground-state results use finite systems and trial-state overlaps/entanglement-spectrum checks; no experimental measurement is claimed.
ai_technology: A symmetry-adapted neural-network wavefunction is optimized by variational Monte Carlo for interacting electrons across Landau-level fillings.
